a6f0ee47d39f644678b6abe2777ba31606f962e1.pinyin: xiè de áo zú xiàng liǎng bǎ xiǎo xiǎo dāo jiàn.
a6f0ee47d39f644678b6abe2777ba31606f962e1.text: 蟹的螯足像两把小小刀剑。

a6f1102364c988ecb9c3cbfdddfce24e711d7eae.pinyin: xià wǔ kāi shǐ guā fēng le.

a6f18e61ae2ffab7a67d59ed6c1cc248b545ff56.pinyin: tā cù méi bù yǔ, yī zhí yōu xīn chōng chōng.
a6f18e61ae2ffab7a67d59ed6c1cc248b545ff56.text: 她蹙眉不语，一直忧心忡忡。

a6f47df2618f1710d8980ba5e9840836b8af3b5b.pinyin: zhǎn lǎn chén liè le huáng qí biāo běn.

a6f544569f25b1b6530c94c59322f8e5ba264023.pinyin: chá jī shàng pū zhe yī kuài lán sè sī chóu.
a6f544569f25b1b6530c94c59322f8e5ba264023.text: 茶几上铺着一块蓝色丝绸。

a6f6086a938bc66b9e4b31ee70b1afb7aa752696.pinyin: gē ge zài zhōng xué cān jiā le lán qiú duì.

a6f69969f400f052e0e909211871385005a3dcc6.pinyin: tā zhǎo dào le jǐ wèi zhì tóng dào hé de huǒ bàn.
a6f69969f400f052e0e909211871385005a3dcc6.text: 她找到了几位志同道合的伙伴。

a6f7f455434e41e20a3647bb3d20ac958bb52993.pinyin: zhào zhe shuō míng àn bù jiù bān de zuò, hěn kuài jiù néng wán chéng.
a6f7f455434e41e20a3647bb3d20ac958bb52993.text: 照着说明按部就班地做，很快就能完成。

a6fbdac0c6105d5a54a4325f6f1e098c6139603a.pinyin: zǒng tǐ shàng shuō, rì běn de qì hòu wēn hé.
a6fbdac0c6105d5a54a4325f6f1e098c6139603a.text: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

a6fef09c3c753bc002890f24ef8bb737f17904ec.pinyin: xì xiǎo de qīng líng tíng zài shuǐ cǎo shàng.
